proFeatures.message:
🚀 Pro features:
• Unlimited history, collections, environments
• Import/export Postman, Insomnia, Bruno; import OpenAPI
• Run collection
• GraphQL, WebSocket, SSE
• Digest Auth and OAuth 2.0
• Binary body, scripts, tests, codegen

Price: $5/month

multipartHint.message: multipart: lines key=value, or attach files below

docsNameHint.message: Rename the request in the field next to the tabs.

sslHint.message: Local only · Chrome cannot ignore invalid SSL

proModalText.message: “{name}” is available on the Pro plan.

proModalFreeNote.message: Free already includes unlimited tabs, HTTP methods, Bearer / Basic / API Key, JSON / form / multipart / text bodies, cookies, docs, JSONPath, 2 collections (25 saved requests), 1 environment (10 variables), history up to 50, cURL, and PingTo JSON import/export.

proModalHint.message: Turn on the Pro toggle in the sidebar to unlock. Later this will be a paid plan.

proHistoryHint.message: History over 50 items is a Pro feature.

proDesc_graphql.message: GraphQL is a query language for APIs: you ask for exact fields instead of a fixed REST response. Pro adds a query editor, variables, schema introspection, and a GraphQL body type so you don’t have to paste JSON by hand.

proDesc_websocket.message: WebSocket is a two-way live connection (you send and receive). SSE (Server-Sent Events) is a one-way HTTP stream from the server. Pro lets you connect, watch messages arrive, and send frames on WebSocket.

proDesc_digest.message: HTTP Digest Auth proves the password with a hash instead of sending it in the clear (unlike Basic). Used by some cameras, routers, and older APIs. Free already covers Bearer, Basic, and API Key.

proDesc_oauth.message: OAuth 2.0 obtains an access token (client credentials or authorization code) and attaches it to requests. Needed for many APIs that don’t accept a static token.

proDesc_binary.message: Binary body sends a raw file as the request payload (images, protobuf, zip). Multipart form uploads with files are already in Free.

proDesc_scripts.message: Pre-request scripts run JavaScript before Send — set headers, timestamps, signatures, or derived variables.

proDesc_testsResp.message: Response tests run assertions after Send (status, JSON fields, timing) and show pass/fail in the Tests pane.

proDesc_snapshots.message: Snapshot stores the current response so you can compare later changes.

proDesc_diff.message: Diff compares the latest response with a saved snapshot and highlights what changed.

proDesc_codegen.message: Code generation turns the current request into copy-paste snippets (JavaScript, Python, PHP, Go).

proDesc_collectionRun.message: Run collection is in the collections sidebar. It sends every saved request in the selected collection in order, with optional stop-on-fail, and shows which ones passed.

proDesc_bruno.message: Bruno is in the Import and Export menus. Pro imports .bru files and exports a Bruno bundle for the Bruno client and git workflows. PingTo JSON stays free.

proDesc_importCollections.message: Import and Export in the sidebar open a format menu. Free is PingTo JSON only. Pro adds Postman Collection v2, Insomnia and Bruno (import and export), plus OpenAPI import.

proItemImportDesc.message: Import and export menus: Postman, Insomnia and Bruno both ways; OpenAPI import. PingTo JSON stays free. Pick the format, then the file.

proItemBrunoDesc.message: Bring .bru files in and export a Bruno bundle. Same Import/Export menus as Postman and Insomnia.

proItemRunDesc.message: Button in the collections sidebar. Runs every request in the selected collection and reports failures.

proDesc_historyCap.message: Free keeps the last 50 history items. Pro raises the cap to 2000.

proItemHistoryDesc.message: Keep far more past requests with search and restore. Free stops at 50.

proItemGraphqlDesc.message: Query editor, variables, introspection, and GraphQL JSON body type.

proItemWebsocketDesc.message: Live two-way sockets (WS) and one-way server streams (SSE).

proItemDigestDesc.message: Challenge-response login for APIs that reject Basic or Bearer.

proItemOauthDesc.message: Fetch and attach access tokens (client credentials and authorization code).

proItemBinaryDesc.message: Send a raw file as the body. Multipart file fields are already in Free.

proItemScriptsDesc.message: Run JavaScript before each send to compute headers, signatures, or variables.

proItemTestsDesc.message: Assert on the response, freeze a snapshot, and diff later replies against it.

proItemCodegenDesc.message: Copy the request as JavaScript, Python, PHP, or Go.

proDesc_loadtest.message: Load testing is not run inside Chrome — start the PingTo load agent for your OS (Windows .exe, macOS/Linux binary). It sends many parallel HTTP requests using the current URL, headers, auth and body, then streams RPS and latency percentiles back.

proItemLoadtestDesc.message: Local agent: ramp or hold profile, abort if the API fails or slows down, live p50/p95/p99. Open Load test.

collectionHelp.message: Create a collection, click its name to select it, then Save request. Click a request to open it. Double-click a collection to rename or delete.

importFailed.message: Unknown format. Use PingTo JSON, Postman v2, Insomnia, OpenAPI or Bruno.

importPingtoOnly.message: Free can import PingTo JSON only. Postman, Insomnia, OpenAPI and Bruno import are Pro.

importExportHint.message: Import/Export: PingTo JSON is free. Postman, Insomnia, Bruno and OpenAPI import, plus Postman/Insomnia/Bruno export, are Pro. Choose a format from the Import or Export menu.

collectionTargetNone.message: No collection selected — Save will create one

freeCollectionLimit.message: Free includes 2 collections. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited collections.

freeCollectionOverQuota.message: Free keeps 2 collections unlocked. {n} extra stay saved (lock icon) — delete them or upgrade to Pro. Nothing was deleted.

freeCollectionLocked.message: This collection is over the Free limit of 2. Open requests here needs Pro, or delete extra collections to unlock the next ones.

authHelp.message: Pick one auth type. PingTo sends it with Send; unused types are ignored.

authHint_none.message: No credentials. Use this for public endpoints.

authHint_bearer.message: Sends Authorization: Bearer <token>. Paste the access token only, without the word Bearer.

authHint_basic.message: Sends Authorization: Basic with username and password (Base64). Common for older HTTP APIs.

authHint_digest.message: Pro. After a 401 Digest challenge, PingTo computes the response. Same username/password fields as Basic.

authHint_apikey.message: Sends a named key as an HTTP header or as a query parameter (for example X-API-Key).

authHint_oauth2.message: Pro. Client credentials: PingTo calls the token URL. Auth code + PKCE: Login opens the browser, then stores the token.

cookiesHelp.message: Cookies live in Chrome for this request URL’s site, not inside PingTo. Load lists cookies Chrome already has. Set writes one cookie so the next Send can include it.

docsHelp.message: Docs are notes for this request only (what it does, sample bodies). They are not sent to the server. Rename the request in the field next to the tabs.

codeHelp.message: cURL: paste a curl command to fill this request, or copy this request as curl. Code (Pro): generate the same request in JavaScript, Python, PHP or Go to paste into your app.

wsHelp.message: WebSocket is a two-way connection. Set method to WS, enter a ws:// or wss:// URL, Connect, then type messages and Send.

sseHelp.message: SSE (Server-Sent Events) is a one-way HTTP stream. Set method to SSE, enter an https:// URL, then Connect. Events appear in the log. There is no Send — the server only pushes data.

freeRequestLimit.message: Free includes 25 saved requests. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited saves.

freeEnvLimit.message: Free includes 1 environment. Upgrade to Pro for more.

freeEnvVarLimit.message: Free includes 10 environment variables. Upgrade to Pro for more.

envHelp.message: Create an environment, add variables (for example base_url), select it in the top bar, then write {{base_url}} in the URL, headers or body.

envHintSelect.message: Select or create an environment, then use {{variable}} in the URL.

envHintNoVars.message: No variables yet — open + Environment and add base_url

envSelected.message: Environment selected — use {{name}} in the URL

envCreated.message: Environment created with base_url. Use {{base_url}} in the URL.

wsNeedUrl.message: Enter a ws:// or wss:// URL

responseEmpty.message: Send a request to see the response

hintTimeout.message: Request timed out or was cancelled. Increase timeout in Settings or check the server.

hint401.message: 401 Unauthorized — check Bearer/Basic/OAuth credentials and environment variables.

hint403.message: 403 Forbidden — the token may lack scope or the resource is protected.

hint404.message: 404 Not Found — verify the URL, path params and selected environment.

hint429.message: 429 Too Many Requests — back off and retry.

hint5xx.message: Server error — the API is failing, not the client.

hintNetwork.message: Network error. This is usually DNS, TLS, mixed content, or the server is down. Chrome cannot ignore invalid SSL certificates.

loadtestHelp.message: A load test repeats the current HTTP request many times in parallel. Chrome cannot open that many connections — download the PingTo agent for this OS, run it, then Check agent. The agent only listens on this computer (127.0.0.1).

loadtestAgentHint.message: Address of the running agent on this computer. Default http://127.0.0.1:8788. Run the downloaded file, then Check agent.

loadtestWorkersHint.message: Maximum simultaneous clients (the top of the ramp, or the level to hold). Like N users clicking Send together. Max 200.

loadtestProfileHint.message: Ramp: clients increase evenly from 1 to the peak over the time you set; when the peak is reached the test stops. Hold: a short warmup to the peak, then that load is kept for the hold time.

loadtestRampHint.message: For ramp: how long the climb from 0 to peak lasts (then stop). For hold: warmup before the plateau — 1000–2000 ms is a fast rise. Max 10 minutes.

loadtestHoldHint.message: Only for “reach and hold”: how long to keep the peak after warmup. 30000 = 30 seconds at target load.

loadtestDurationHint.message: How long the test lasts. Used only by the constant profile.

loadtestCountHint.message: 0 = ignore. For example 1000 = stop after 1000 requests even if the ramp or hold is not finished.

loadtestRpsHint.message: 0 = no limit (as fast as current clients can go). 1000 = the agent aims for about 1000 requests/s at the peak of the profile. The report shows now (last second), average (whole run), and max (best 1-second window). Average is pulled down by the ramp. If now stays well below the target, add parallel clients or the server cannot keep up.

loadtestTimeout.message: Give up on one request after (ms)

loadtestTimeoutHint.message: If a single request has no response in this time, it is a timeout in the report. Does not stop the whole test by itself — use abort rules below for that.

loadtestAmmoTitle.message: Ammo and compensation (POST, DELETE, PUT, PATCH)

loadtestAmmoHelp.message: The same POST or DELETE without unique cartridges will collide: duplicate keys, 404 after the first delete, leftover rows. Ammo is a JSON array of shots. Omitted method/url/headers/body inherit the current request. {n} is the 1-based shot index for this run. Compensation runs only after a successful main request and is not counted in RPS. Global compensate is method + URL with {n} only — one body cannot describe thousands of different shots; put compensate.body on the cartridge.

loadtestAmmoHint.message:
Empty = current request as-is (GET needs no ammo).

POST create, then DELETE the same {n}:
[{"body":"{\"id\":\"{n}\",\"email\":\"user-{n}@load.test\",\"name\":\"User {n}\"}","compensate":{"method":"DELETE","url":"http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/users/{n}"}}]

DELETE a pool of real ids, then POST each one back (restore body belongs on the cartridge):
[
  {"method":"DELETE","url":"http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/sessions/s-alpha","compensate":{"method":"POST","url":"http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/sessions","body":"{\"id\":\"s-alpha\",\"user\":\"alpha\"}"}},
  {"method":"DELETE","url":"http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/sessions/s-beta","compensate":{"method":"POST","url":"http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/sessions","body":"{\"id\":\"s-beta\",\"user\":\"beta\"}"}},
  {"method":"DELETE","url":"http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/sessions/s-gamma","compensate":{"method":"POST","url":"http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/sessions","body":"{\"id\":\"s-gamma\",\"user\":\"gamma\"}"}}
]

After POST+compensate, GET http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/stats (users ≈ 1). POST /v1/reset reseeds.

loadtestCompHint.message: Optional global second request: same method and URL template for every shot ({n} only). Typical after POST: DELETE http://host/v1/users/{n}. Leave empty when each cartridge has its own compensate — that is the DELETE → restore POST case, where every body is different.

loadtestAbortTitle.message: Abort if the service cannot hold

loadtestAbortHelp.message: The test stops itself (status aborted) when the API is failing or too slow. 0 disables a rule. Checks start after the grace period and a minimum number of requests, so a couple of errors at the start do not trip it.

loadtestAbortErrorHint.message: Share of failed + timed-out requests. 20 = stop if one in five is not HTTP 2xx/3xx. 0 = off.

loadtestAbortP95Hint.message: 95% of requests should be faster than this. If p95 grows past the limit, the service is saturated. 0 = off.

loadtestAbortStreak.message: Stop after N failures in a row

loadtestAbortStreakHint.message: Emergency brake when the API is down (all 5xx/timeouts). 0 = off.

loadtestAbortAfterHint.message: Do not abort on the first errors. 20 = wait until 20 requests have finished, then apply the rules.

loadtestAbortGraceHint.message: Ignore abort rules at the very beginning (cold start, TLS). 2000 = first 2 seconds never abort.

loadtestReportHint.message: The dashboard updates live: status, throughput, error rate, latency charts, outcome mix and HTTP codes. The text report is under the charts if you need exact numbers.

loadtestAgentFail.message: Agent unavailable: {error}. Download the agent for this OS, run it, then Check agent again.

loadtestNeedHttp.message: Load testing needs an HTTP method, not WS/SSE.

loadtestBodySimple.message: Load testing supports none/json/form/text bodies. Multipart and binary are not sent through the agent.

loadReportRpsAvg.message: Average over the whole run, req/s

loadReportLatencyHint.message: How long the server took to answer one request. p50 = typical; p95/p99 = slower tail. Below 1 ms extra digits are shown (localhost is often 0.05–0.5 ms, so 0.0 was only rounding).

loadAbort_consecutive.message: too many failures in a row

loadDlTrust.message: The file is not inside the Chrome extension. Download it only with the button below (official release). The build is not code-signed yet: Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may warn. The agent accepts traffic only on 127.0.0.1. After download, compare SHA-256 with the catalog.

loadDlShaPending.message: Will appear in the release catalog after CI publishes a tag

loadDlUnsigned.message: This build is not Authenticode / notarized. Trust the official catalog URL and the hash, not a file from chat.

loadDlNoRelease.message: If the file 404s, run scripts\publish-loadtest.cmd in cmd.exe (Go, Node, gh auth), then Reload catalog.

loadDlUpdate.message: agent {current} is older than catalog {latest} — download again
